dcterms:description: A publicly available dataset for grapheme-to-phoneme conversion, containing 108,952 training words, 5,447 validation words, and 12,855 test words. The dataset includes grapheme and phoneme vocabulary sizes of 27 and 39 respectively, with stress markings removed and multiple pronunciations retained.
dcterms:title: CMUDict 0.7b

dcterms:description: An internal dataset used for grapheme-to-phoneme conversion, containing 184,243 training words, 10,837 validation words, and 21,678 test words. This dataset includes uppercase and lowercase letters and stress markings.
dcterms:title: Internal English Dataset
